admin_login_challenges_terminal_state_ex.name: admin_login_challenges_terminal_state_exclusive
admin_login_challenges_terminal_state_ex.value:
not (
            "admin_login_challenges"."consumed_at" is not null
            and
            "admin_login_challenges"."invalidated_at" is not null
          )

admin_recovery_codes_terminal_state_excl.name: admin_recovery_codes_terminal_state_exclusive
admin_recovery_codes_terminal_state_excl.value:
not (
            "admin_recovery_codes"."used_at" is not null
            and
            "admin_recovery_codes"."revoked_at" is not null
          )

admin_sessions_revocation_pair.name: admin_sessions_revocation_pair
admin_sessions_revocation_pair.value:
(
            "admin_sessions"."revoked_at" is null
            and
            "admin_sessions"."revocation_reason" is null
          )
          or
          (
            "admin_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null
            and
            "admin_sessions"."revocation_reason" is not null
            and
            char_length(
              btrim(
                "admin_sessions"."revocation_reason"
              )
            ) > 0
          )
